transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, your clinical conversational agent. I conducted your post-cataract surgery follow-up check, and I'm here to answer any questions you may have about your recovery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start doing light gardening, like gentle weeding or watering, about 1 week after surgery. However, it's best to avoid bending, lifting, or heavy physical activity for about a month. It's also a good idea to wear protective eyewear while gardening to avoid any accidental water or debris getting into your eyes. Does that help? Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should have been prescribed some preservative-free eye drops to help with dryness. It's recommended to use them four times daily to start. If you're running out, you can contact your GP for more. You can start using them as soon as you need to, but I would recommend using them as directed by your doctor. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: Some sensitivity to light is normal, especially when you're adjusting to the new lenses. However, if it's severe or accompanied by redness and pain, we'd want to check on that further. If it's just mild, you might want to try wearing sunglasses when you're outside. Does that make sense? Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some sensitivity to light is normal, especially when you're adjusting to the new lenses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's also a good idea to wear sunglasses when you're outside to help with the sensitivity. If your sensitivity is severe or you're experiencing pain, it's best to contact your care team for further advice. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, one more question. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery. But it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it's okay.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for clarifying that. I don't have any more questions now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: All your questions have been answered. Have I answered all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all of my questions. Thank you for your help!
